/about/.title: About
paragraphs: I am a follower of Christ, a wife to Johan, and a mother to the sweetest boy. Being behind the lens - capturing the essence of who you and your loved ones are - brings me the greatest joy and fulfilment!
I've lived all around South Africa. From Pretoria, a hut in the Wild Coast, all the way to the most southern tip of Africa. Currently, we are based in Bloemfontein, but don't mind travelling!
I have a natural and warm photography style that is a mix of candid, photojournalism-style moments and posed photos. So don't worry about feeling awkward in front of the camera - I've got your back!
I value relationships, so I hope to be there to capture more than just one of your special events.
© 2026 Van Eck Photography
